title: Seed Round Sizing
description: How much should you raise in your seed round? Too little starves the runway; too much dilutes prematurely.

decision.prompt: Choose your seed raise amount and the valuation cap you'll negotiate.

options.label: Raise $500k
options.description: Minimal dilution, tight runway — forces rapid prioritisation and lean execution.

options.label: Raise $1.5M
options.description: Standard seed size, 12–18 months of runway to find product-market fit.

options.label: Raise $3M
options.description: Extended runway and team-building capacity, but higher dilution and investor expectations.

runway_months.label: Target Runway (months)
runway_months.description: How many months of runway you want the raise to cover.

burn_rate_monthly.label: Monthly Burn Rate ($)
burn_rate_monthly.description: Current or projected monthly cash burn in dollars.

arr_at_raise.label: ARR at Time of Raise ($)
arr_at_raise.description: Annual recurring revenue at the time you close the round.

team_size.label: Team Size
team_size.description: Number of full-time employees (including founders) at time of raise.
